source_pattern_name_zh: 生物医学实验设计与机制选择
activation_signals: The problem asks "how many controls are required" or "which sequence / which kinase family fits".
The answer is a natural number or a single letter, but obtaining it requires listing the full set of required controls or matching the motif to the correct family.
The problem provides channel counts / sequence fragments / reagents and expects domain-convention-driven aggregation.
problem_signatures: 题目要求"到底该准备多少对照""该用哪种激酶/哪段序列"这类针对具体实验的最小必要集合问题。
答案是一个自然数或一个选项字母，但决定答案的是对实验基线 + 专业惯例的完整覆盖。
likely_failure_modes: Counting only "channels" without adding negative / isotype / live-dead / bead-only controls.
Guessing a kinase family from a motif without aligning the motif against the family's consensus.

sop_phases.title: Phase 1 — Enumerate Baseline Requirements
steps: For experiments such as flow sorting, list every baseline control (unstained / live-dead / FMO / isotype / single-stain / beads-only / substrate-free).
For kinase-selection problems, expand the motif's precise consensus sequence (e.g. CaMK: R-X-X-S/T).
Confirm the answer dimension (integer vs option letter).

sop_phases.title: Phase 2 — Apply Problem-Specific Dimensions
steps: Expand "one single-stain + one FMO per channel"-style rules by the channel count.
Kinase matching: residue-by-residue against each candidate family's consensus, ruling out "similar but wrong" families.
Sum the necessary controls or score the candidate families.

sop_phases.title: Phase 3 — Self-Audit & Output
steps: Self-check: did you include generic controls intrinsic to the experiment type (FSC/SSC reference for flow sorting)?
For motif questions, re-verify that the problem's motif exactly matches the chosen family's variable-position consensus.
Integer answers as bare numerals; multiple-choice answers as a single uppercase letter.

subtype_playbook: **Flow-sorting controls**: baseline = unstained + live-dead + FMO_per_channel + single-stain_per_channel + beads-only + isotype; expand by channel count and sum.
**Kinase motif matching**: align against CAMK (R-X-X-S/T), PKC, CK2, etc. consensus sequences residue by residue.
**Gene regulatory map**: turn the problem's interaction map into an adjacency list before inferring.
output_rules: Integer answers are bare numerals with no prefix or unit.
Multiple-choice answers are a single uppercase letter.
